product.title: Old Monterey Walking Food Tour

description.text: Taste Old Monterey on a guided walking food tour through historic adobe districts, Fisherman's Wharf, and Cannery Row corridors. Sample local seafood, artisan bites, and regional specialties while learning Monterey's Spanish and sardine-era history.

highlights: Guided Old Monterey walking food tour
Tastings across historic downtown and waterfront areas
Learn Monterey adobe and Cannery Row history
Route covers Fisherman's Wharf and Cannery Row

end.description: Tour ends near Cannery Row or downtown Monterey.
